purpose: Bounded E3 engineering qualification of the shared core, exact task journal and model-driven action loop; not a generalization or capability-promotion study.

fixtures.roles_note: Train cases author alignment targets; dev cases carry controls; held-out cases are used once for model-driven episodes and never for alignment or control tuning; the interrupted case is exercised in separate guarded CLI processes.

alignment.auxiliary_optimizer: adamw (FP32) for embeddings, heads, slot queries and non-2D tensors

arms.name: recurrent
arms.initialization: migrated E2 parent for E2 tensors, fresh E3 tensors

arms.name: feedforward_control
arms.initialization: the same migrated E2 parent after restoring its new-parameter snapshot; shared sensors/readers are trained by this arm and swapped only for control evaluation; the recurrent arm is restored afterward and is the only exported arm

alignment.example_order: deterministic round-robin over (train case, teacher step) in sorted case-id and ascending step order
alignment.loss: teacher-forced next-token cross entropy on the generated action JSON plus EOS; prompt prefix masked, never supervised
alignment.previous_workspace_during_alignment: absent (zero-initial previous state); cross-decision workspace input is exercised at inference and restart, not trained here
alignment.teacher_policy: host-authored action sequence used only to create training labels and real training-tool receipts; never used to choose evaluation actions

generation.raw_output_policy: retain token IDs and raw text for every decision, including malformed proposals

evaluation.interruption_plan: guarded CLI invocation 1 stops after observing the failed test; a host-only correction bumps the task revision; guarded CLI invocation 2 resumes in a fresh process and must rebuild incompatible workspace state
evaluation.success_rule: only the independent evaluator command run by the host may satisfy the success condition
engineering_acceptance: independent memory and workspace reader influence
gradients through sensors, core and workspace readers
denied goal replacement and unverified obligation completion
evaluation.learned_capability: reported from held-out task outcomes and controls; a small exposed fixture family cannot establish generalization

controls.core_disabled: memory branch only; no CoreState and no workspace readers
controls.workspace_zero: core computed, workspace zeroed before readers
controls.workspace_shuffled: another task's stored workspace with matching producer
controls.ff_core: matched feed-forward core trained with the same declared alignment budget
controls.extra_inference: one additional known-input sense pass with the workspace branch disabled
controls.ff_core_training: sequential arm of the same 16 updates and 4-example batches, starting from the same migrated parent; shared sensors/readers are trained by that arm and swapped for its control episode only; no FF-arm weights are exported
controls.claim: controls are bounded engineering comparisons; no statistical superiority claim; shared-reader coupling is reported as a confound

success_head.kind: task-success prediction from detached task features plus pooled first-decision workspace
report: Brier score on the same exposed labels
success_head.authority: prediction only; never declares task success

checkpoint.save_policy: one final extension-only export after alignment and, if trained, success-head fitting; no base copy, no optimizer checkpoint
checkpoint.retention: keep the parent E2 extension, this final extension, all raw reports, journals and failure traces

stop_conditions: capacity guard stop (40 GiB sampled driver, 512 MiB sustained swap growth, 15% minimum free memory)
nonfinite loss, gradient or generated logits

claims.implemented: shared recurrent core, workspace readers, exact task journal, typed actions and tools, model-driven loop, restart
claims.trained: modules-only action-format/core/reader alignment and, conditionally, the success head
claims.measured: engineering checks, held-out task outcomes, controls and costs under the declared budgets
claims.not_claimed: generalization, calibrated confidence, self-improvement, Replica fidelity, full-bank memory capacity, retrieval quality
